patch.value: Resolve human-agent decisions in a shared inbox

Collaborative web workflow over core Plan decisions with alternatives, evidence and audited SDK responses. Concurrent responses use revision checks; view-only users cannot apply; acknowledgments never count as code review or task completion. Typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, remedies, docs, no-git and public tracker validation, browser screenshots.
